title: Notion
lyrics:
[00:11.77]Sure it's a calming notion, perpetual in motion
[00:17.89]But I don't need the comfort of any lies
[00:23.92]For I have seen the ending, and there is no ascending
[00:30.40]Rise
[00:35.89]Oh, back when I was younger, was told by other youngsters
[00:41.77]That my end will be torture beneath the Earth
[00:47.90]'Cause I don't see what they see, when death is staring at me
[00:53.83]I see a window, a limit, to live it, or not at all
[01:26.96]If you could pull the lever to carry on forever
[01:32.68]Would your life even matter anymore?
[01:38.94]Sure it's a calming notion, perpetual in motion
[01:45.05]But it's not what you signed up for
[02:03.99]I'm sure there won't always be sunshine
[02:10.17]But there's this momentary beam of light
[02:15.84]You don't have to wait those salty decades
[02:18.60]To get through the gate, it's all in front of your face
[02:21.98]I'm sure there won't always be sunshine
[02:28.06]I'm sure there won't always be sunshine
[02:34.24]But there's this momentary beam of light
[02:39.36]I could-could cross the ocean in a fit of devotion (I'm sure there won't always be sunshine)
[02:45.45]For every shining second, this fragile body beckons (But there's this momentary beam of light)
[02:51.46]You think you're owed it better believing ancient letters (I'm sure there won't always be sunshine)
[02:57.47]Sure it's a calming notion, but it's a lie (But there's this momentary beam of light)
